answer: Each epoch, vault judges grade the work a key submits and, if it passes, sign one dawn onto that key's record. The vault then mints each key quartz voting weight equal to its dawns squared. An honest agent with 100 signed dawns votes 10,000 quartz. To cast that same 10,000 quartz through 100 clones, an operator needs 10 dawns per clone: 1,000 judged dawns of real work, ten times the honest bill. A thousand clones would need 3,162 dawns, so every extra head makes the same influence dearer.
